label: The findings checker cannot see the finding shape its own doctrine prescribes, so that shape passes vacuously: review-core.md section 7 writes findings as headings with the number inside ('### 2 [P1] Missing authorization check') while check-review-findings.js matches only list items (/^(\d+)\. \S/). Observed: a faithful review-core-shaped review printed 'OK: no numbered findings to check' and exited 0, while the same review in the template list shape is checked line by line. The checker README's claim that it checks each numbered finding under ## Findings is false for one of the two shapes the packet documents. Reproducing case: run the checker on a review-core-shaped review. NEW P1.

A double space after 'Not checked:' is rejected with a message claiming the line is absent: the checker requires ^Not checked: \S, so 'Not checked:  two spaces after colon' failed with 'FAIL: no "Not checked:" line above the status line' and exit 1, while the README describes the requirement only as 'must start with Not checked: followed by text'. The rejection is defensible under the exact-string contract; the message and the README wording are not. Reproducing case: the two-space sample under the lineage scratch folder. NEW P2.

Verified: the final-line checker's documented behaviour reproduces exactly - trailing space on the status line failed with 'final line is not an exact status line' and exit 1, the blank-line and Not checked placement rules held, and a skip status must be the whole output, matching the README row. ALREADY-ADOPTED, no action.
